description: Audit preset for the November 2026 Riemann Hypothesis claim (Alpöge / Claude, Lean). Allowed axioms are the three Lean standard axioms. The preset audits the code and the evidence; it does not re-run the Lean kernel.
evidence: Lean & Mathlib joint statement (2026-11-21): 'We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct.' (Lean community blog, 2026-11-21.)

MIT verification record (Andrew Sutherland): 175,187 modules compile with zero errors; only the three standard axioms; independent kernels nanoda and con-leche accept the full export — https://math.mit.edu/~drew/grh/
Statement proved is Mathlib's own Riemann Hypothesis definition (in the library since 2023), not a version written by the authors.
Clay Mathematics Institute still lists the Riemann Hypothesis as unsolved; the $1M prize needs peer-reviewed publication and two years of scrutiny.
name: rh
